content.short: CitaDAO is a global marketplace for tokenized real estate, secured on the blockchain.
content.description: CitaDAO provides a platform for diversifying portfolios through tokenized real estate assets while offering yield farmers access to sustainable yield opportunities. Real estate landlords can list properties on-chain using an Introducing Real Estate On-chain (IRO) process, with a roadmap toward full decentralization to support seamless, trustless transactions. By operating across Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, and Avalanche, the platform connects real-world assets with on-chain liquidity, enabling diverse buyers and investors to participate in property-based yields with lower entry barriers and transparent processes.
